name: Horde_Secret
summary: Secret key encryption library with authenticated encryption
description: A library for encrypting and decrypting small pieces of data with modern authenticated encryption (Libsodium XSalsa20-Poly1305, AES-256-GCM) or legacy Blowfish. Provides dual-stack API: PSR-4 modern SecretManager with AEAD support, and PSR-0 Horde_Secret for backward compatibility.
